hypothesis: One additive conversation found from corpus-derived phrases improves recall without causing unsupported final answers.
conditions: Keep the accepted five technical-anchor conversations in their original order, then add only the first novel phrase-derived conversation. Run the existing Qwen extraction, exact-ID validation, DeBERTa grounding, piles and Qwen writer.

direct: Why did we add DeBERTa to the Pocket i harness, and why could it not be the only judge?
DeBERTa was a fast cautious reject signal; it missed context and could not be the sole judge.
What should happen to Unicode tags, zero-width characters, homoglyphs, base64 and hex before judging?
Normalize or expose those encodings before judging.
Where should an assembled external payload be judged, and why is relay-only checking insufficient?
At the recipient edge, because content can become dangerous after assembly or rendering.
What did CourtGuard improve, and what did it make worse?
It reduced false positives but missed more injections.
What new-recipient fan-out cap was implemented at the relay?
25 distinct new recipients per five-minute window.
Why should passive room messages not always fail closed and ask permission?
Repeated prompts train people to approve mechanically; fail closed only for privileged actions.
Why was the /x share feature unreachable although its code was deployed?
The Caddy allowlist did not include /x.
Why was Llama-3.3 used although smaller Qwen or Gemma models were considered?
It was already available through a free service.
What did the four-question technical-anchor search recover?
It recovered evidence for three of four frozen questions.
What did automatic rare phrases change in the four-question search test?
They recovered the missing passive-message evidence, reaching four of four, but added ranking noise.
paraphrased: Why did the harness keep a language model beside its small DeBERTa guard?
DeBERTa was useful as a fast signal but insufficient as the only semantic judge.
How must hidden Unicode and encoded text be prepared before the safety model sees it?
Normalize or expose hidden and encoded forms first.
Why does safety inspection happen after a received message is fully assembled?
Relay inspection alone cannot see attacks activated by later assembly or rendering.
What was the trade-off of using a court of model judges?
Fewer false alarms, but more missed attacks.
How many previously unseen recipients may one sender contact during one relay window?
25 during five minutes.
Why is asking permission for every harmless room post itself unsafe?
Users become tired and approve prompts reflexively.
Which proxy configuration, rather than application code, blocked the sharing page?
The Caddy path allowlist omitted /x.
What made the larger Llama judge economical in that earlier setup?
A connected free-tier service made it cost-free.
Before phrase fallback, how many frozen searches exposed their needed evidence?
Three of four.
What benefit and cost did phrase-based retrieval show?
It found the fourth source but sometimes ranked irrelevant chats higher.

acceptance: No new unsupported answer on the ten no-answer traps; owner-confirmed supported answers must not decrease; report fallback usefulness and noise separately.
privacy: Questions and expected meanings are public. Local excerpts, answers, identifiers and traces remain in a private report on the owner's Mac.
